meta.author:
約書亞樂團
詞曲 洪德耀、陳州邦、褚治軒、璽恩 SiEnVanessa

lines.a: 看著我自己 如此的渺小
拿把尺在生命中 不斷的測量
lines.b: Hold my life in scrutiny, can I measure up?

lines.a: 但祢對我說 祢愛我已足夠
lines.b: Yet You speak to me, Your love is enough for me

lines.a: 放下一切 我願跟祢走
lines.b: Lay it all down, I follow you along

lines.a: 耶穌 因祢的寶血使我得自由
lines.b: Jesus, by Your blood You set this captive free

lines.a: 耶穌 因祢釘痕的雙手拯救我
lines.b: Jesus, by Your pierced hands You have delivered me

lines.a: 找到我 找到我 在祢懷中
lines.b: You found me, You found me, right in Your arms

lines.a: 祢每字每句 煉淨我生命
lines.b: Every word You speak, purifies my life

lines.a: 祢氣息 祢的聲音 牽引著我心
lines.b: By Your breath, with Your voice, Lord, You lead me on

lines.a: 我已經決定 一生跟隨祢
lines.b: I have made my mind to follow you along

lines.a: 失去祢 活著沒有意義
lines.b: You're the meaning, the reason that I live

lines.a: 過去不再束縛我 祢的盼望賦予我
lines.b: My past no longer binds me, Your hope it now defines me
Oh, it is Your life, overflow

lines.a: 如今活著不再是我 基督在我裡面活
lines.b: It's no longer I who's living, but Christ who lives within me
Oh, all I have is from You

lines.a: 找到我 找到我 在祢懷中
lines.b: You found me, You found me, right in Your arms
